next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.18.3 SR1: identifier-1 in any Data Division section; a Report Section item must be PAGE-COUNTER, LINE-COUNTER or a sum counter of the same report. §2023:13.18.53.3 SR4: 'Identifier-1 specifies a data item defined in any section of the data division. If identifier-1 specifies a report section item, it shall be a report counter identifier or a sum counter defined in the current report', and §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR1 lets PAGE-COUNTER and LINE-COUNTER be referenced in the report section 'only in a SOURCE clause'. Same set of operands; the arithmetic-expression extension is new syntax only. Both are compile-time rules.
